evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge.
